nodes.name: Weekly Sweep 03:00 IST
nodes.notes: Weekly retention and health sweep at 03:00 Asia/Kolkata (timezone set in workflow settings), outside business hours.

nodes.name: Get Expired email_events
nodes.notes: Finds email_events whose retention_expires_at is in the past and still have a raw text_body. Documented retention = 30 days from received_at (set at intake).

nodes.name: Redact Expired Bodies
nodes.notes: Redacts/removes expired raw content (text_body) while preserving audit metadata (message_id, category, importance, confidence, processing_status, received_at, retention_expires_at). Processes each expired record (P2-E2E-015).

nodes.name: Get Stuck/Failed Records
nodes.notes: Reports stuck/failed records: processing_status in failed, review_required (open review), or received (not yet triaged).

nodes.name: Build Health Report
nodes.notes: Deterministic health report from stored state. No AI.

nodes.name: Send Health Report
nodes.notes: Delivers the retention/health report to the configured owner mailbox with the connected Gmail credential.
